description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join an early-stage AI team building reinforcement learning systems from the ground up. You will own the end-to-end process, from environment design and model training to evaluation, helping shape the technical direction and engineering culture.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Design and build reinforcement learning environments, reward functions, and training pipelines.

 - Train and fine-tune models using methods such as PPO, GRPO, DPO, RLHF, and RLAIF.

 - Develop evaluation frameworks to measure model and agent performance.

 - Run experiments, interpret results, and decide what to explore next.

 - Scale training on GPU clusters and keep training pipelines reliable.

 - Turn research ideas into production systems.

 - Help establish engineering practices and hire future team members.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - At least 2 years of hands-on experience in reinforcement learning or machine learning engineering.

 - Strong Python skills and deep experience with PyTorch or JAX.

 - Practical experience training models with reinforcement learning methods, including policy gradients, reward modeling, or RLHF.

 - Experience with distributed training, GPU infrastructure, RL environments, reward functions, training pipelines, and model or agent evaluation.

 - A track record of taking research ideas into production systems.

 - A degree in computer science, mathematics, physics, or a related field; a master's or PhD is a plus.

 - LLM post-training or agent training experience is beneficial, as are RL publications or open-source work and experience with simulation frameworks or training libraries.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary: $125,000 to $200,000 USD annually. Visa sponsorship is available.


LOCATION

On-site in San Francisco, California, United States. Candidates must be based in or willing to relocate to San Francisco.
